calibration: archived publisher STO/CPO estimates applied identically to all methods; receiver-referenced channel amplitude, not dBm
coherence: within one link/packet only; no cross-antenna/array phase proof asserted

licenses.DICHASUS: CC BY4.0 per archived official DaRUS metadata; source attribution and provenance in docs/RADIOJEPA_CSI_DATA_AUDIT.md

limitations: Digitally masked previously measured CSI; not actual sparse on-air sounding or PHY latency.
First1024 CRC-verified prefix frames, not the complete recordings.
cf06 training at1.272GHz; ad00/dc01 about3.44GHz also differ in environment/receiver geometry; domain shift is confounded, not isolated zero-shot band or device proof.
Publisher STO/CPO calibrations may themselves use broader calibration acquisition; available equally to baselines, not estimated from task targets.
Finite-band circular Fourier coefficients do not identify scatterers, materials, absolute delays or causal paths.
Same-packet links and temporal frames are correlated; packet quantiles are descriptive, not iid uncertainty; neural seed SD reflects only3 training runs.
No warehouse robot task,100-car deployment,MAC interference planning,wireless protocol transfer or service reliability qualification follows from CSI completion alone.
No SOTA or novel-first claim without external matched benchmark comparisons.
lmmse_transfer: TRAIN covariance transfers by normalized frequency-bin index; dc01 sampled grid has slightly different Hz spacing, not learned channel covariance on target band

model.alignment: raw receiver-gauge predicted-field IFFT coefficients divided by fixed TRAIN-pilot RMS; undo independent pilot phase/scale before comparing
model.reference: circular finite-band receiver relative gauge; no physical path identity
model.scale_and_phase: each branch uses only its16 pilots; frozen global scale uses TRAIN union32 pilots only

primary_metric: mean over packets of target error energy / target channel energy, aggregate antennas and32 target bins per packet, then average A/B views; report3 independent neural seed mean and SD
prior_observation_disclosure: All acquired prefixes and cf06 spatial partition were previously inspected for other tasks. This new pilot-completion task has not yet been fitted/scored; no global unseen data or confirmation claim. NPZ loads complete raw arrays into memory; feature selection excludes digitally held target bins.
selection: lowest cf06 spatial-validation primary NMSE checkpoint, fixed40epochs each arm; Fourier/LMMSE hyperparameters selected only on same validation
task: measured same-packet same-antenna digitally masked complex pilot completion

test_domains.dichasus-ad00: all1024 previously acquired prefix frames, all64 antennas
test_domains.dichasus-cf06: pose-blocked test rows from same recording
test_domains.dichasus-dc01: all1024 previously acquired prefix frames, all64 antennas
